_note: A child placed in a named slot (`<div slot="footre">`) is destructured from the component's `$$slot_def["footre"]` whether or not it carries a `let:` directive (upstream `addSlotName` for every `slot=` child), so a slot name the component does not declare is reported — TS2551 with a suggestion when a close name exists, TS7053 otherwise. We only opened that check when a `let:` was present, so a typo'd slot name passed silently.
